claim.quote: Using exposures on the order of one kilogram-day from initial runs of our experiment, we have achieved (preliminary) upper limits on the WIMP-nucleon cross section that are comparable to much longer runs of other experiments.

name: Preliminary Limits on the WIMP-Nucleon Cross Section from the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search (CDMS)

summary.plain: The first published CDMS limits: from about one kilogram-day of data, already comparable to much longer runs of other experiments. They were labelled preliminary.
summary.technical: TAUP97 proceedings: Ge (165 g NTD, 1.60 kg d) and Si detectors at the 17 m.w.e. Stanford site; phonon plus ionization discrimination; plan to continue at the Soudan mine.

title: Preliminary Limits on the WIMP-Nucleon Cross Section from the Cryogenic Dark Matter Search (CDMS)
why_it_matters: Marks the start of CDMS limits from cryogenic Ge/Si detectors with simultaneous phonon and ionization readout.
